transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, honestly, the thing that kind of scared me into actually making an appointment is that my eating has just been completely all over the place lately. 

Like... some days I'll just forget to eat meals entirely. I just won't even think about it. But then other nights, I'm up after midnight just tearing through takeout and whatever snacks I can get my hands on. It's just really out of the ordinary for me, and I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
Over the same period when your eating has been irregular, how has your mood been? Have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed, or have you been feeling more anxious or worried?

Honestly, no, not really. I haven't felt down or depressed at all. Um, and I wouldn't say I've been anxious or worried either. My mood has just been pretty normal, I guess. It's really just the eating habits that have been weird.
You mentioned being up after midnight eating. How has your sleep been overall? Are you having trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up too early?

Yeah, my sleep has definitely been off. Most nights, I either can't fall asleep at all because my mind just keeps running through my sales pitches for work, or... if I do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before my alarm goes off. 

And the weird part is, even though I know I barely got any actual sleep, I wake up feeling completely wired.

You mentioned feeling 'wired' despite minimal sleep. During these times when you're feeling energized, do you find yourself taking on more projects or activities than usual, or feeling like you can accomplish more than you normally can?

Yeah, definitely. There were days recently where I just had so much energy that I was doing... well, everything. I was rewriting all my pitch decks, calling up a ton of customers, mapping out new sales routes... I was basically trying to fix every single account at once instead of just slowing down and pacing myself. I just felt like I could take it all on and get it all done.

Have you ever experienced a period like this before—where you had a lot of energy, needed very little sleep, and felt like you could do everything at once? Or have you ever had the opposite, where you felt very down and depressed for an extended period?

Yeah, actually... I know I said earlier I wasn't feeling down right now, but as for the opposite, I definitely have. 

For about four months, I was dealing with this really low mood. I just felt a lot of guilt and... I didn't really care about things anymore. It just lingered for a while, and it definitely got a lot harder to ignore after I had some trouble at work.

When you're feeling this wired energy right now and accomplishing all these things at work, how would you describe your overall mood? Are you feeling particularly good, happy, or elevated compared to your usual baseline?

Well, it kind of bounces around. Like, some mornings I wake up feeling... I don't know, almost unbeatable. Like I'm absolutely certain I can outsell every single person in my region. I feel really good, really confident. 

But then... it doesn't take much to change that. Just one small comment from my manager, or a client pushing back on a price, and I just... I get set off way more than I normally would. I get really irritated, really fast. So it's a mix of feeling on top of the world and then just snapping at people.
How long has this period of high energy, confidence, and irritability been going on? Has it been days, weeks, or longer?

Well, let's see... this whole thing, the energy and feeling like that, it's been going on for about a month now. It basically started right around the time I got into that big fight with my regional manager. So, yeah, since then.

You mentioned this high-energy period has been going on for about a month now. During that entire month, has the energy, confidence, and irritability been pretty much constant, or have there been days where it let up or went away?

Yeah, it's been pretty constant. Like I said, this whole thing... the energy, the feeling wired, the snapping at people... it's all been going on non-stop since that fight with my regional manager about a month ago. It hasn't really let up at all.

During this past month of high energy and irritability, has this affected your ability to work or your personal relationships in a significant way? Have you had to take time off work, or has it caused serious problems that required intervention?

Well, yeah, it definitely has. Um, at work, my manager actually started pulling me off some of my accounts. I guess I've been making mistakes that I normally wouldn't make. And, uh, HR even got involved after I had to make that employee-assistance call. I mean, I haven't taken time off, I'm still showing up every day, but... between work and things at home, it just feels like everything is slipping out of my control right now.

You mentioned this high-energy period has been going on for about a month now. During that month, on how many individual days would you say you experienced this wired energy, confidence, and irritability? Was it every single day, or were there some days mixed in where you felt more like your normal self?

I mean, like I was saying a minute ago, it really has been every single day. I haven't had any days mixed in where I felt like my normal self. It's just been that same wired feeling straight through the whole month.
